svg.aria-label: Horizontal bar chart of nine models on 8-class modulation recognition: 1-D CNN 0.909, DLNN trained for the board line 0.878, cumulant classifier 0.875, DLNN with float readout 0.851, DLNN 0.806, feature MLP 0.783, reservoir 0.718, MLP-L 0.542, raw MLP 0.261.

g.text: pink: the ternary delay-line net. 0.806 with a ternary readout, 0.851 with a float readout on the microcontroller,
0.878 when trained for the simulated board line.
a float 1-D CNN of the same shape (blue) scores 0.909, and a 208-parameter cumulant classifier (teal) 0.875.
MLPs on raw I/Q cannot learn the random carrier phase at either size; the dashed line is chance, 0.125.
